chapter: Later tours, illness and the union job
title: Zurich Casabar and the Swiss recording with Henri Chaix
summary: In recent years he played Zurich's Casabar and made 'Swinging the Blues' with Swiss musicians.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well now, what about the last the most recent years?
Last, well you mean since the last five years?

Well that's when I was in the, I went to France to play with, no I didn't really go to France, I went to Copenhagen. And then I played between Copenhagen and Zurich. I used to play Zurich all the time at a place there called the 'Casabar' as a single. They had a good swinging group there. And I made a recording with all of the best musicians in Switzerland that I could use.
Henri , he's a band leader there.
Yes, he was a Swiss band leader.
Yes. I always thought that would be Chez.
Yes, but even he himself pronounced it Henri Chaïx.
Oh, that's the way it's done. That's the German influence again.
